integrity: Complete proofs are stated for the nonzero-balance reduction, the finite-height passage kernels and Narayana weighting; all numerical checks use the enclosed executable files and are independently reproducible.
scientific_limitations: The formula enumerates losing words, not general nimbers; finite verification is supplemental and coefficientwise enumeration is not a simple asymptotic.
title: Narayana–Chebyshev enumeration of losing positions in a balanced-end subtraction game
